title: 抽牌预览 (Draw Peek)
description:
中文
作者：wuxingogo

战斗中预览下回合预计抽到的整组卡牌，支持随游戏语言切换的卡名与升级标记。模组界面自动跟随游戏语言：中文使用简体中文，英文及其他语言使用英文。悬停顶部卡牌图标展开，点击可固定面板，再次点击恢复悬停模式。

支持基础地图奖励预测：悬停当前可前往的未走过节点，查看战斗、精英、问号与宝箱的基础预测信息。预测基于当前状态，特殊效果与其他模组可能改变最终结果。

必需前置：RitsuLib 0.6.9 或以上兼容版本，安装并启用后使用 Ctrl+Shift+F9 打开模组设置，选择抽牌预览并启用。RandomForeseer 为可选增强依赖。

当前版本：1.3.2。项目记录适配游戏 v0.111.0。

更新记录
v1.3.2：修复顶栏卡牌图标被遮挡；打开暂停、设置及其他覆盖菜单时暂时隐藏图标和预览面板，关闭后恢复并保留固定状态。
v1.3.0：新增完整中英文界面，战斗抽牌预览、地图奖励提示和设置页自动跟随游戏语言切换；中文语言使用简体中文，英文及其他语言使用英文。卡牌、事件、药水和遗物名称继续使用游戏自身的本地化。

English
Author: wuxingogo

Preview the cards expected to be drawn next turn during combat. Card names follow the game language, with upgrade indicators. All mod UI text automatically follows the game language: Chinese locales use Simplified Chinese; English and other locales use English. Hover over the card icon at the top of the screen to open the panel. Click to pin it, then click again to return to hover mode.

Basic map reward predictions: hover over unvisited nodes you can currently travel to for predictions about normal combats, elites, question-mark rooms, and treasure chests. Predictions are based on the current state; special effects and other mods may change the final outcome.

Required dependency: RitsuLib 0.6.9 or a later compatible version. Install and enable it, press Ctrl+Shift+F9 to open mod settings, then select Draw Peek and enable it. RandomForeseer is an optional enhancement.

Current mod version: 1.3.2. The project records compatibility with game v0.111.0.

Changelog
v1.3.2: Fixed the top-bar card icon being obscured. The icon and preview panel hide while pause, settings, or other modal screens are open, then return with the pinned state preserved.
v1.3.0: Added Chinese and English UI for combat draw previews, map reward hints, and settings, following the game language. Chinese locales use Simplified Chinese; English and other locales use English. Card, event, potion, and relic names continue to use the game's own localization.
changeNote: v1.3.2：修复顶栏图标被遮挡；打开暂停、设置及其他覆盖菜单时隐藏预览，关闭后恢复并保留固定状态。 / Restored the top-bar icon. The preview hides while pause, settings, or other modal screens are open and returns afterward with its pin state preserved.
